text: Implemented DatasetTimeAxis with typed RunOrdinal and RunLocalTimepointIndex, DatasetTimeBlock, and DatasetRunPartition. FmriDataset now owns a validated timeAxis derived from SamplingFrame by default and exposes runPartitions/runPartitionsEither for selected DataSelection values. Added shared tests for global-to-run-local mapping, censored/subselected partitions, duplicate/out-of-bounds rejection, default run ids, and explicit typed run ids. Verified warning-clean with sbt datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test: JVM 36 passed, JS 25 passed.
